message.content:
1) Approximate banner height: 50px (it appears to be a standard height for a promotional banner).  
2) Number of lines of 'Fraktfritt i Norge over 2500,-' text: 4 lines (the text repeats 4 times in the banner).  
3) Line spacing: Tight (small gap between lines, as the repeated text is compactly arranged).  
4) Position relative to the dark navy header: No visible gap/margin between them—the banner sits directly below the navy header, with the bottom edge of the header aligning with the top edge of the banner.
